fields.title: Week of Oct 20 – Oct 26
fields.headline: $88K of ARR at risk across two accounts; Harbor Point’s champion has left.
fields.body:
**At risk — $88K**
- **Cedar & Pine** ($52K, renews Jan 15): route-sync bug, two sites on paper.
- **Brightline HVAC** ($36K, renews Mar 1): September invoice unpaid, integration promise missed.

**Watch closely**
- **Harbor Point** ($96K, renews Dec 20): champion left Oct 21. Score still 56, but usage is falling.

**Changed since last week**
- Meridian added nine seats for Denver.

fields.title: Week of Oct 27 – Nov 2
fields.headline: $184K of ARR is at risk; Harbor Point turned red six weeks before renewal.
fields.body:
**ARR at risk: $184K** across 3 of 14 accounts (24% of $754K), up from $88K.

**At risk**
- **Harbor Point Logistics** — $96K, renews Dec 20, score 32. Champion left; active seats 78 → 41; NPS 4. Play: executive call with the new operations director by Nov 12.
- **Cedar & Pine** — $52K, renews Jan 15, score 44. Three urgent sync tickets. Play: engineering escalation, due Nov 7.
- **Brightline HVAC** — $36K, renews Mar 1, score 42. Invoice 52 days late. Play: owner call — **overdue since Nov 3**.

**Watch, renewing within 90 days**
- Summit Dental ($48K, Dec 31, score 62) and Lakeside Plumbing ($14K, Jan 28, score 56).

**Decisions for Monday**
1. Send our VP of Customer Success to the Harbor Point call.
2. Approve an October credit for Cedar & Pine.
3. Offer Brightline a split payment.
